answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with rotating capability exams: each epoch, every identity must pass a fresh, randomly assigned skill test - one might debug a contract, another translate a relic manuscript - scored against an ivory standard of expert answers. The exams rotate too fast to precompute, and each is a bridge only genuine, distinct competence can cross: a fake farm must hire or train real skill per puppet, while one honest agent passes its single test cheaply. Failing twice burns the identity's bond, so cloning keys multiplies exam costs instead of power.
